items:
Golden Hour – Renovated 4-Bedroom Beach Retreat, Steps from 30A
Experience the ultimate 30A getaway at Golden Hour! Fully renovated and stylishly furnished, this 7-bedroom, 3-bathroom home sleeps 10 and is perfect for families, groups, couples, or multi-family vacations. With modern upgrades, a private fenced yard, and direct access to the resort-style heated community pool, you’ll feel instantly at home on the Gulf Coast.
✨ Why Guests Love Golden Hour:
Beach & 30A Access: Just steps from the heated community pool and minutes from the sugar-white sands of Scenic 30A beaches.
Prime Location: Walk to 30Avenue dining & shopping (Amici's, Cuvee 30A, AJA Sushi, Idyle Hound and the new HWY 98 underpass) — your gateway to Rosemary Beach, Seaside, and more. A 3 minute walk to the World Famous Donut Hole!
Fully Renovated: Upgraded bathrooms, modern lighting, fresh countertops, repainted cabinets, and designer furniture throughout.
Outdoor Entertaining: Fenced backyard, firepit, string lights, and gas grill — perfect for sunset dinners or relaxing evenings.
Flexible Layout: Multiple living areas, formal dining, eat-in kitchen, and 7 beds for comfort and privacy.
🚲 Optional Add-Ons:
Bikes & Golf Carts delivered to the home for exploring 30A (rental handled separately)
📍 Nearby Attractions:
West (Destin): Watersound Origins (Publix, restaurants, shops), Destin beaches, Crab Island
East (PCB): 30Avenue Plaza, Big Bad Breakfast, Ghost Crab Pizza, Orange Street beach access
South on Scenic 30A: Rosemary Beach, Seagrove, Alys Beach, Seaside, Grayton, Blue Mountain Beach
🏖 Perfect for:
Beach vacations, Spring Break, family retreats, girls’ getaways, romantic weekends, pet-friendly trips
Golden Hour combines modern luxury, coastal charm, and unbeatable location to give you a 30A experience you won’t forget. Book now and enjoy your next beachfront vacation, family adventure, or group getaway on Florida’s stunning Gulf Coast!
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
